questions.prompt: Which country's revolution of 1789 produced the Declaration of the Rights of Man?
questions.fact: A companion declaration of women's rights was written two years later; its author was executed in 1793.

questions.prompt: Which mineral gives blood its red colour?
questions.fact: It is the iron binding oxygen that shifts the colour, which is why oxygenated blood is brighter.

questions.prompt: Which sport features an event called the sprint finish?
questions.fact: In cycling it is a team effort, with riders positioning their sprinter until the final few hundred metres.

questions.prompt: Which band released the song Enter Sandman?
questions.fact: It is played before home games by several sports teams, which has made it familiar to people who dislike metal.

questions.prompt: Which country's capital is Wellington's largest city rival, Auckland?
questions.fact: Auckland is built on a field of around fifty volcanoes, most of them dormant rather than extinct.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Bertha Mason?
questions.fact: Wide Sargasso Sea was written specifically to give this character her own history and voice.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Kafka streaming platform?
questions.fact: It was named after the writer, with its creator saying it seemed fitting for a system optimised for writing.
